The Leela Royal Arrival Intelligence Agent
Namaste. I can help prepare today’s VIP arrivals, surface service risks, identify tasteful upgrade or ancillary opportunities, and recommend approval-gated next-best actions for The Leela team.
Show me today’s VIP arrivals and service risks.
Which guests should receive upgrade consideration today?
Find high-value guests at risk of not returning.
Summarize allergy, complaint, and VIP escalations for arrivals this week.
Create an executive arrival-readiness brief for the General Manager.

Create various types of documents and artifacts

Data

Data fetching and processing

2 / 10
Generate Chart

Generate interactive charts and visualizations from recent database query results. Supports bar, line, area, pie, scatter, composed and radar charts.

Smart Suggestions

Generate context-aware follow-up questions and related topic suggestions based on conversation history

Get Qlik Schema

Search Qlik app schema to find available tables, fields, and their types using vector search

Setup Data Pipe

Conversational wizard for setting up data synchronization pipelines. Guides users through connector selection, configuration, data selection, and scheduling.

Get Qlik Data

Execute Qlik hypercube queries to retrieve data with dimensions and measures

Knowledge Base Search
Configure

Search connected knowledge base documents to retrieve relevant information.

Business Context Lookup

Look up business terminology, metrics, rules, and operational context from the semantic layer. Enables AI to understand business-specific definitions and gather missing context from users.

Dataset Search

Search for relevant BI datasets using semantic search. Returns dataset configuration including available metrics, dimensions, temporal fields, and SQL query.

Power BI Query

Execute DAX queries against connected Power BI datasets to retrieve and analyze data

Database Query
Configure

Execute read-only SQL queries against connected databases to retrieve and analyze data

Web Search

Search the web for real-time information, company data, industry context, and general knowledge using neural search

Web Fetch

Fetch and extract content from a specific web page URL. Reads articles, documentation, blog posts, or any publicly accessible page.

Sandbox Code Execution

Execute Python code in a secure sandbox with full pip package support and file generation (DOCX, XLSX, PDF, PNG, etc.)
